summary: Verified Checkout.jsx customer-friendly error UX fix via Playwright with route interception. All 5 scenarios PASSED: (1) 401 Paxity error shows only generic French message with zero technical leakage, (2) 500 error same generic message, (3) network abort shows 'Impossible de contacter le serveur...', (4) OMSN without OTP still shows actionable 'OTP requis' toast, (5) regression - method grid, phone, recap still render and Payer button is re-enabled after failures.
critical_code_review_comments: Console.error still logs raw backend detail (including PAXITY_API_KEY mentions) — acceptable for support but ensure production source maps do not leak this to end-users' error trackers if any are wired to Sentry/etc.
Error banner has no data-testid; consider adding data-testid='paxity-error-banner' for reliable future automation (currently located via bg-destructive class).
seed_data_creation: localStorage sec_cart_v1 seeded with a single Casque item (100 F) inside Playwright session only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Checkout flow: /commande. Step1 fields identified by placeholders (Marie, Dupont, marie@exemple.com, Rue quartier…, Dakar, 77 XXX XX XX). Step2 has a single 'Continuer'. Step3 method tiles by visible label (Wave Sénégal, Orange Money Sénégal…). Payer button located via role=button + text 'Payer'. Error banner div uses class bg-destructive/10.
